items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and approve no new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, experiments, telemetry, or unsupported revenue claims. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The commission is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is reported as $0, which does not prove zero site performance. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are unknown because revenue and cost periods do not align, infrastructure/domain/labor/marketing/experiment costs are incomplete, monthly budget limits are blank, and no learning-outcome threshold is defined. Continue only existing repair-or-close, period-aligned attribution, measurement, and cost reconciliation using recorded telemetry. Treat the productivity pilot as operational output only: treatment shipped output was 70 versus 44 controls, with 58 versus 40 requests, 7 versus 6 failures, 12.21 versus 9.39 average cycle hours, and an empty evaluation; this is not financial or causal lift.

Handoff: retain all four CRO proposals as deferred backlog only. Their metrics are hypotheses or engagement indicators, not evidence of contribution margin, commission, ROI, payback, or causal lift. Do not create change requests, add tracking, install dependencies, deploy, spend, or expand monetization until existing failure, attribution, measurement, validation, rollback, and release gates clear.

Minimum financial evidence required before reconsidering growth work: reconcile provider revenue to site/content/tracking identifiers for the same period as AI and other costs; retain aggregate provider rows as unattributed; add complete AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and experiment cost records; record approved budget ceilings; and define a learning outcome plus maximum cost-to-learn.

Maintain financial containment. Revenue evidence covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission that is not site-attributable. AI usage covers 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-27: 4,892 calls and $890.42 cost. Margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, and budget capacity remain unknown. Do not approve new spend, forecasts, commitments, monetization expansion, or unsupported financial claims.
